Copied top-player route: rated 2,344, rank 384 of 5,225 (top 7 percent)
A route copied move for move from a top player rates well but cannot react. Keep copying, or build an agent that plans its own moves?
Decided: Copied moves were banned, enforced by a check; copied routes stay only as sparring partners.
The next copied build beat it 35 to 5 locally, then levelled off at 1,562 live
Our own build failed its gate below the kill line. Which two entries hold the ladder?
Decided: The floor pair went live; our own lineage came off the ladder.
Floor pair chosen on paired match points against 29 fixed opponents: 0.917 and 0.863
Leader-route entry peaks at 2,413 live, 110 wins and 38 losses
Last evening: replace the 2,352-rated route entry with a new build that hands the farm to our own crew after a set day?
Decided: Uploaded early with the owner's approval; it validated, and the pair froze with it.
Freeze: the best route entry stands at 1,971; the last upload starts from 600
Finding: replaying a top player's exact moves rated 616 points below that player. Reacting, not the route, was the gap.
The own-runtime lane closed on numbers: run by our executor, a leader route's own plan won 27 of 64 games where the route won 60.
The project history ends at the freeze; the final standing comes after it.
